categories.evidence: Modifies src/wallet/test/coinselector_tests.cpp to test SelectionResult behavior in wallet coin selection.
categories.rationale: Adds unit tests covering SelectionResult::Merge and SelectionResult::GetTotalBumpFees to prevent regressions.
